requirement:
`habeas add-input --item <file>:<line>` MUST parse the file under {cite}`requirements.references.outlines` and add or refresh one
outline input for every outline node declared on that line. A named node is
declared on the line where its name begins in the source. An anonymous node, or
a named node whose name is not written in the source, such as an extern block
without an ABI string, is declared on the line where its own syntax starts,
excluding attached comments and attributes. Each input MUST store the selected `file` under the path
rules in {cite}`requirements.ci.schema`, the node's selector, and its structural
hash. The command MUST report every selected node and reject a line on which no
node is declared.

`habeas add-input --item <file>:<line>` MUST parse the file under {cite}`requirements.references.outlines` and add or refresh one
outline input for every outline node declared on that line. A named node is
declared on the line where its name begins in the source. An anonymous node, or
a named node whose name is not written in the source, such as an extern block
without an ABI string, is declared on the line where its own syntax starts,
excluding attached comments and attributes. Each input MUST store the selected `file` under the path
rules in {cite}`requirements.ci.schema`, the node's selector, and its structural
hash. The command MUST report every selected node and reject a line on which no

:::{req} outlines
Habeas MUST parse Rust, Python, TypeScript, CSS, Markdown, TOML, and YAML
sources with pinned tree-sitter grammars, selected by file extension compared
case-insensitively. A source with any syntax error MUST fail to parse, reporting
the line of its first error. Every
other text file MUST use a plain-text profile in which each line that is not
blank is an anonymous outline node of kind `line`. Each supported language MUST
have an outline profile that maps grammar node kinds to short outline kind names
and, for each mapped kind, states whether a node is named, and by which fields
or children, or anonymous. Only mapped kinds MUST appear in the outline; other
nodes MUST be transparent, so their outline descendants appear under the
nearest outline ancestor. A profile MAY attach grammar siblings to an outline
node, such as Rust attributes and doc comments preceding an item, so the outline
tree need not match the grammar tree exactly; attached siblings are part of that
node for its line range and hash. Every file's outline MUST have a root node
for the whole file, independent of language. Source in no other outline node,
such as top-level statements no profile maps, MUST belong to the root node;
profiles MUST NOT invent fallback kinds for it. Comments MUST NOT be outline nodes. Profiles MUST be
documented. Upgrading a grammar or profile MAY change outlines and MUST be
treated as a deliberate change.
:::{req} schema

A requirement or example evidence file at `evidence/<full-name>.json` MUST be a JSON object with exactly `requirement` or `example`, `determination`, `rationale`, `references`, and `inputs`. `references` MUST be the reference-set digest defined by {cite}`requirements.ci.reference_set`. The definition text and rationale MUST be nonempty strings, `determination` MUST use one of the outcomes defined by {cite}`requirements.ci.outcomes`, and `inputs` MUST be an array. Every evidence input MUST have exactly one of three forms: an outline input with `file`, `item`, and `hash`; a requirements input with `requirements`, `matches`, and `text`; or a definition input with `definition` and `text`. File paths MUST resolve to permitted inputs under {cite}`requirements.ci.input_containment`. Project-local paths SHOULD be recorded relative to the project for portability; absolute and parent-relative paths MAY be used when their resolved targets are permitted. `matches` MUST be an array of distinct full definition names, `hash` MUST be a lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 digest, and `text` MUST be a nonempty array of strings. Evidence MUST NOT store source text for outline inputs.
